notes: Polite formal register: statements and messages in 합니다체 ("저장하지 못했습니다"), requests as ~하세요/~해 주세요, questions to the user as ~하시겠습니까?; never address the user with a pronoun (no 당신/귀하), just omit the subject. Buttons and labels are short nouns or noun phrases ("저장", "표지 다운로드", "다시 시도"); step titles end in ~하기. Keep the English em dash " — " in error messages. Straight double quotes "…" around UI option names, as the English does; option names on Lulu's or Google Fonts' English-only sites stay in English. Use the single-character ellipsis "…". Avoid particles directly after a {placeholder} whose final sound is unknown — attach a noun instead ("{binding} 방식으로", "{bw} 옵션을"). Keep Paper Bible, Lulu, Google and PDF unchanged. Bible quotations follow 개역개정 wording; "chapter" is 장, Old/New Testament 구약/신약; interior pages are 내지; booklet binding is 소책자; columns are 1단/2단.
